classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Analyze Portal
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: Gain analyze portal as a spell-like ability usable once per gatecrasher level per day, using character level as the sorcerer caster level.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Bonus Language
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: Choose one planar language at 1st level and again at 4th, 7th, and 10th level. The source lists Abyssal, Aquan, Auran, Celestial, Ignan, Infernal, and Terran as common choices.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Comprehension
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 2nd level gain a +2 insight bonus on Decipher Script and Use Magic Device checks and a +2 insight bonus when searching for or disabling magic traps.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Open Portal
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 3rd level force a portal open with an Open Lock check using Intelligence instead of Dexterity. Opening a portal takes 1 round and is a full-round action; a successfully opened portal remains open for 1d4+1 rounds.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Summon Spell Dampening
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 4th level, three times per day create a 100-foot dampening field for 10 rounds that suppresses summoning and calling spells and spell-like abilities within the field.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Silver Tongue
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 5th level gain a +2 insight bonus on Bluff, Diplomacy, Gather Information, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Planar Survival
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 6th level become personally immune to the natural planar effects that would be negated by avoid planar effects; this attunement does not protect against the same damage when it is not a natural effect of the current plane.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Damage Reduction
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 7th level gain damage reduction 5/+1 under the D&D 3.0 rules: ignore the first 5 points of qualifying damage unless the attack is from a +1 or better magic weapon, a spell, or energy. It does not stack with other damage reduction.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Scramble Portal
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 8th level use scramble portal as a spell-like ability three times per day, using gatecrasher level as the sorcerer caster level.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Plane Shift
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 9th level use plane shift once per day as a spell-like ability, functioning as the spell cast by a 15th-level sorcerer.

classes/gatecrasher-602.name: Planar Dampening
classes/gatecrasher-602.description: At 10th level, three times per day emit a 30-foot planar dampening field for 10 rounds. It suppresses newly used spells and spell-like abilities that access other planes and restricts summoning, calling, and shadow effects as described by the source.
